title: Goongɗinɗo mo suuɗii e nder Ñaawirde Tiran
intro: E nder cuuɗi gildeeji laamɗo ɓurɗo mawnikinaare anndiraaɗo e Quraan — ɗo ƴattoore Alla sifotoo kala yamiroore — ruuhu gooto ina yaha e nder ɓurɓe teeŋtude, ina suuɗa sirluuji ɓurɗi bonde e gite laaɓtuɗe. Oo neɗɗo ina joginoo iimanaagal haɗaangal e nder ɗeen ɗoon galleeji haa yiytude ɗum ina firta maayde laaɓtunde. Kono tan hoolaare ina wuli no 6uu6ol les 6uu6ol nii, nde waktu oo yottii, goonga ina 6uu6too e cuusal, ina diwta 6uu6ol suudu 6uu6ol ngol.
clues: Miɗo wuuri e nder taarik ndernderiijo laamɗo ɓurɗo doole e mawnikinaare e jamaanu am, tawi miɗo taarnaa e njulaagu e doole.
Mi suuɗii gooŋɗinal am goonga e nder ɓernde am, miɗo hula nguurndam am e laamiiɓe tooñannge e tooñannge.
Nde leñol am sikkitii, 6uuccii e yeeso goonga, mi 6uucciima ngam jeertinde 6e e bonanndeeji 6urcfi bonde e lexxi 6alee6e 6ee, calii nul6e Joomiraacfo mum en.
Mi siftinii leñol am daartol suka gorko giɗo koyɗol, mo banndiraaɓe mum njippini, tee ummiima e laamu mawngu e nder leydi woɗɗundi.
Miɗo ñaagii leñol am nde woppataa ɗooftaade laamɗo majjuɗo, miɗo nodda ɓe nde ɓe ndewata e am e laawol peewal e ardaade.
Mi haali goonga e peeñcu hay so tawii almuɓɓe tippudi ndii ina ndartini mi e kaaƴe walla riiwtude mi e leydi ndii.

verse: And he who believed said, "O my people, follow me; I will guide you to the way of right conduct. (40:38)
